<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 900 400" width="900" height="400" role="img" aria-labelledby="t d" xmlns:c2pa="http://c2pa.org/manifest"><metadata><c2pa:manifest></c2pa:manifest></metadata>
  <title id="t">Sayeed Mahmud</title>
  <desc id="d">Terminal window typing: whoami, Sayeed Mahmud, Full Stack Developer (Learning), React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB. Open to freelance work.</desc>

  <style>
    text { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono','Fira Code',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace; }
    .cmd  { font-size: 18px; fill: #d9f2e4; }
    .p    { fill: #5cf2a0; }
    .name { font-size: 40px; font-weight: 700; fill: #f2fff7; }
    .role { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; fill: #5cf2a0; }
    .stack{ font-size: 18px; fill: #9fc4b0; }
    .note { font-size: 15px; fill: #6f9482; }
    .ttl  { font-size: 14px; fill: #6f9482; }

    /* typing reveal: a clip rectangle grows in steps, one step per character */
    .k { width: 0; }
    .k1 { animation: w1 .9s  steps(20,end) .4s  both; }
    .k2 { animation: w2 .8s  steps(13,end) 1.5s both; }
    .k3 { animation: w3 1.1s steps(26,end) 2.6s both; }
    .k4 { animation: w4 1.2s steps(31,end) 3.9s both; }
    .k5 { animation: w5 1.1s steps(25,end) 5.3s both; }
    .k6 { animation: w6 1.6s steps(44,end) 6.6s both; }
    @keyframes w1 { to { width: 225px; } }
    @keyframes w2 { to { width: 330px; } }
    @keyframes w3 { to { width: 295px; } }
    @keyframes w4 { to { width: 460px; } }
    @keyframes w5 { to { width: 285px; } }
    @keyframes w6 { to { width: 490px; } }

    .late   { opacity: 0; animation: show .3s ease 8.3s forwards; }
    .cursor { opacity: 0; animation: blink 1s steps(1,end) 8.3s infinite; }
    @keyframes show  { to { opacity: 1; } }
    @keyframes blink { 0% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0; } }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .k, .late, .cursor { animation-duration: .01s; animation-delay: 0s; }
    }
  </style>

  <defs>
    <clipPath id="c1"><rect class="k k1" x="40" y="78"  height="30"/></clipPath>
    <clipPath id="c2"><rect class="k k2" x="40" y="108" height="50"/></clipPath>
    <clipPath id="c3"><rect class="k k3" x="40" y="174" height="30"/></clipPath>
    <clipPath id="c4"><rect class="k k4" x="40" y="212" height="34"/></clipPath>
    <clipPath id="c5"><rect class="k k5" x="40" y="264" height="30"/></clipPath>
    <clipPath id="c6"><rect class="k k6" x="40" y="302" height="30"/></clipPath>
  </defs>

  <!-- window -->
  <rect width="900" height="400" rx="18" fill="#08110d"/>
  <rect x="16" y="16" width="868" height="368" rx="14" fill="#0d1a14" stroke="#1d3a2c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="16" y1="64" x2="884" y2="64" stroke="#1d3a2c" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="40" r="6" fill="#1d3a2c"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="40" r="6" fill="#1d3a2c"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="40" r="6" fill="#1d3a2c"/>
  <text x="450" y="45" text-anchor="middle" class="ttl">sayeed@dev: ~/portfolio</text>

  <!-- typed lines -->
  <g clip-path="url(#c1)"><text x="52" y="100" class="cmd"><tspan class="p">~/portfolio $</tspan> whoami</text></g>
  <g clip-path="url(#c2)"><text x="52" y="148" class="name">Sayeed Mahmud</text></g>
  <g clip-path="url(#c3)"><text x="52" y="196" class="cmd"><tspan class="p">~/portfolio $</tspan> cat role.txt</text></g>
  <g clip-path="url(#c4)"><text x="52" y="238" class="role">Full Stack Developer (Learning)</text></g>
  <g clip-path="url(#c5)"><text x="52" y="286" class="cmd"><tspan class="p">~/portfolio $</tspan> echo $STACK</text></g>
  <g clip-path="url(#c6)"><text x="52" y="324" class="stack">React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB</text></g>

  <!-- final prompt, blinking cursor, availability note -->
  <text x="52" y="358" class="cmd late"><tspan class="p">~/portfolio $</tspan></text>
  <rect class="cursor" x="205" y="342" width="10" height="20" fill="#5cf2a0"/>
  <text x="848" y="358" text-anchor="end" class="note late"># open to freelance work</text>
</svg>
